result.paraphrase: Exos 7E8 key benefits: suited for hyperscale applications and cloud datacenters, large-scale scale-out data centers, OLTP and HPC workloads, high-density RAID storage, mainstream enterprise external storage arrays, distributed file systems such as Hadoop and Ceph, enterprise backup and restore including D2D and virtual tape, and centralized surveillance. Technical specifications: base model ST4000NM0025, 4TB capacity, 128MB cache, SuperParity yes, low halogen yes, PowerChoice Technology yes. Reliability/data integrity: 512 bytes per sector, 5-year limited warranty. Performance: 7200 RPM spindle speed, 12.0/6.0/3.0 Gb/s interface access speed, 215MB/s maximum sustained transfer rate OD, 4.16 ms average latency. Physical dimensions: 1.028 in/26.1 mm height max, 4.010 in/101.85 mm width, 5.787 in/147.0 mm depth, 680 g/1.5 lb weight.
